AveXis, Inc. (AVXS) Reaches $216.60 High on May, 1; Nbw Capital Has Decreased Apple (AAPL) Stake
May 1, 2018 - By Ellis Scott
The stock of AveXis, Inc. (NASDAQ:AVXS) reached all time high today, May, 1 and still has $229.60 target or 6.00% above today’s $216.60 share price. This indicates more upside for the $7.97 billion company. This technical setup was reported by Barchart.com . If the $229.60 PT is reached, the company will be worth $478.44 million more. The stock increased 1.85% or $3.94 during the last trading session, reaching $216.6. About 1.04M shares traded or 25.96% up from the average. AveXis, Inc. (NASDAQ:AVXS) has risen 59.28% since May 1, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 47.73% the S&P500.

The Nbw Capital Llc holds 83,989 shares with $14.21 million value, down from 93,099 last quarter. Apple Inc now has $850.10 billion valuation. The stock increased 1.38% or $2.2795 during the last trading session, reaching $167.5395. About 11.09M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since May 1, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500.
Analysts await AveXis, Inc. (NASDAQ:AVXS) to report earnings on May, 10. They expect $-1.95 EPS, down 82.24% or $0.88 from last year’s $-1.07 per share. After $-2.55 actual EPS reported by AveXis, Inc. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts -23.53% EPS growth.
Among 4 analysts covering AveXis ( NASDAQ:AVXS ), 3 have Buy rating, 0 Sell and 1 Hold. Therefore 75% are positive. AveXis had 5 analyst reports since May 13, 2016 according to SRatingsIntel. The firm has “Market Perform” rating by Wells Fargo given on Friday, July 15. The firm has “Buy” rating by Bank of America given on Friday, October 21. The firm has “Buy” rating given on Friday, May 13 by Goldman Sachs.
AveXis, Inc., a clinical-stage gene therapy company, engages in developing and commercializing treatments for patients suffering from rare and life-threatening neurological genetic diseases. The company has market cap of $7.97 billion. The Company’s initial product candidate is AVXS-101, a gene therapy product candidate that has completed Phase I clinical trial for the treatment of spinal muscular atrophy Type 1. It currently has negative earnings. The firm also intends to identify, acquire, develop, and commercialize gene therapy product candidates for the treatment of other rare and life-threatening neurological genetic diseases.
